name: Spark Needle (Lôi Tinh Châm)

arts.name: Spark Prick (Lôi Tinh Thích)
arts.rule: A needle of static: a quick Lightning hit that lays 2 Thunder stacks on the foe for 6 s.

lore: A copper needle that crackles when drawn from its sleeve; Storm-sect outer disciples are taught to throw it first.
build_use: The Crit Storm's first weapon: a cheap, quick Lightning hit that lays Thunder debuff stacks, so the foe takes crits harder from the start.

name: Static Band (Tĩnh Điện Giới)
lore: An iron ring wrapped in a thread of lightning-struck copper; hair stands up near it.
build_use: The Crit Storm: a little linh lực back on every crit, the early stand-in for Storm Battery.

name: Forked-Light Sword (Phân Quang Lôi Kiếm)

arts.name: Forked Slash (Phân Lôi Trảm)
arts.rule: Counts as a Thousand-Bolt Scripture art. A quick Lightning slash; each crit it lands raises your crit chance by 5 for 3 s, stacking. In Overload Form, or with 3 Charges or 3 Peals, or three scripture arts fired in one pulse, it hits 2.2 times as hard.

lore: A sword whose blade was split by a bolt and reforged in the fork, so it cuts twice.
build_use: The Crit Storm and The Thunder Drum: a fifth Thousand-Bolt Scripture art that the suite's Palm, Chain Arc and Peal count, and its crits keep the crit chance climbing.

name: Thunderclap Bell (Lôi Minh Chuông)

wards.name: Thunderclap Toll (Lôi Minh Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter bell at 1.4 times its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (3.019 of 3.050)

lore: A bronze bell that rings by itself when lightning is near, and its ring is a shield.
build_use: The Thunderclap: a bell for the boss fighter facing slow heavy hits, with lightning resistance and crit chance on the side.

name: Stormcaller's Drum (Hô Lôi Cổ)

reserve_arts.name: Stormcaller's Cadence (Hô Lôi Tiết)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Lightning arts have 8 more crit chance and fire 4 % faster.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W

lore: A war drum from a Thunder sect's rain-calling rites; each beat is answered from the clouds.
build_use: The Thunder Drum: crit chance and speed set the beat, and Steady Breath rewards keeping the pool full while Storm Battery refills it.

name: Stormcloud Armour (Vân Lôi Giáp)

wards.name: Cloudflash Shell (Vân Thiểm Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.6 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: Dark scale armour that flashes with heat lightning when struck.
build_use: The Crit Storm: a fast-cast shield for art-speed crit builds, with lightning resistance against Thunder sects.

name: Peal-Heart Pendant (Lôi Tâm Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Peal-Heart Aura (Hồi Lôi Tâm Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Lightning arts have 9 more crit chance and deal 30 % more crit damage.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W

lore: Violet jade with a bolt frozen inside; it thrums like a second heart.
build_use: The Thunderclap and The Crit Storm: Marked Prey rewards the Thunder stacks and Slowed Time laid on the foe, and the aura stands in for a crit passive.

name: Tribulation Rod (Độ Kiếp Lôi Trượng)

effects.name: Lightning Drinker (Ẩm Lôi)
effects.rule: When a Lightning part hits you, 20 % of the damage it deals after resistance returns as linh lực.
effects.from: variant-thunder.md, The Tribulation Rider (its New piece)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

lore: A rod of black iron drawn from a tribulation crater; its first owner stood under the bolt and lived.
build_use: The Tribulation Rider: Lightning foes and tribulation waves refill the pool instead of draining it.

name: Seal of the Ninth Tribulation (Cửu Kiếp Lôi Ấn)

effects.name: Verdict Stands (Phán Quyết Bất Diệt)
effects.rule: Your Thunder debuff stacks on a Slowed target cannot expire.
effects.reads: Slowed Time on the target, live
effects.payload: Thunder stacks on a Slowed foe never expire
effects.closes: Thunder stacks you lay on a foe that is not Slowed last 25 % shorter.
effects.from: new (The Thunderclap's 'delay, then the clap'; Tribulation Seal's verdict)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

arts.name: Ninth Verdict (Cửu Kiếp Phán)
arts.rule: Counts as a Heavenly Tribulation Scripture art. A slow Lightning seal that lays 4 Thunder stacks for 8 s; each crit it lands lays 1 more (twice a pulse at most). With 6 Thunder stacks on the foe and also a foe Slowed twice, a foe at 50 % health or three scripture arts in one pulse, it consumes 6 of them to hit 6 times as hard.

holder: An elder of a Thunder sect at Nascent Soul; otherwise Lost on a thunder-scarred peak
lore: The seal that bound the ninth lightning of a heavenly tribulation, and kept it.
build_use: The Thunderclap: Slowed Time makes its Thunder stacks permanent and the verdict consumes them for one huge crit; a fourth Heavenly Tribulation Scripture art.

name: Heartbeat of Heaven Drum (Thiên Tâm Lôi Cổ)

effects.name: Drumbeat (Cổ Tiết)
effects.rule: Every fourth art you fire in a fight is a guaranteed crit, and each such crit gives you 1 Thunder buff stack.
effects.closes: Your other arts have 8 less crit chance.
effects.from: variant-thunder.md, The Thunder Drum (a steady-count crit, without the keystone)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Heaven's Pulse (Thiên Mạch)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Lightning arts fire 8 % faster and deal 40 % more crit damage.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 20 % reserved buys up to 20 W

holder: The head of a Thunder sect, kept in its rain-calling hall; otherwise Lost in a drowned thunder temple
lore: A drum whose skin is said to be a cloud, and whose beat the sky repeats.
build_use: The Thunder Drum: the count of four is the build's rhythm, art speed shortens the beat, and every drum crit builds the Thunder buff.

name: Winnings Band (Lôi Thắng Giới)
lore: A ring of braided gold and storm-iron, won in a dice game under a thunderhead; every bolt that lands pays the wearer back.
build_use: The Crit Storm and the gambler builds: a grade 3 Lightning ring where each crit refunds linh lực, so fast crit arts feed their own pool.
notes: Answers: first-volley: a Thunder ring of grade 2-3 with crit or art-speed modifiers; loaded-dice: a ring that refunds linh lực on crit at grade 3 (Winnings) and a second Thunder ring above grade 1; unique-ninth-tribulation-seal: a grade 3 Lightning ring. Plain spend about 34.1 W of 38.3.

name: Stormveil Robe (Lôi Mạc Bào)

wards.name: Stormveil Drain (Lôi Mạc Hộ)
wards.notes: The Common Ward at 1.3 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: A grey robe threaded with rain-silk; its qi hangs about the wearer like a thundercloud and is spent slowly.
build_use: The Crit Storm: a standing drain ward the engine can run, with lightning resistance and crit and speed on the side.
notes: Answers: first-volley: a Thunder ward armour with a drain ward. Plain spend about 24.5 W of 25.6.

name: Lightning Step Charm (Lôi Bộ Bội)
lore: A jade sliver that flickers like a bolt between clouds; the wearer is gone before the thunder arrives.
build_use: The Crit Storm: an escape piece for Lightning Step, whose first firing comes at once and whose escape cools faster.
notes: Answers: first-volley: a Thunder escape or step item for Lightning Step. Plain spend about 24.1 W of 25.6.
